the probiotic strains L. acidophilis, E. faeium, B. subitlis and S. cereviesiae were selected for the production of FAC and that the FAC diet improved broiler performance, meat quality and fatty acid composition.
the selected microbial strains were highly tolerant to acid, bile, heat, and the addition of FAC to broiler diet increased growth, meat quality, and fatty acid content.
the probiotic strains L. acidophilis, B. subtile, S. cerevisia and E. faecum can be used to produce FAC, which can be used to improve growth and meat quality of broilers.

the development of a new feed additive for poultry.
the selection of appropriate probiotic strains and the evaluation of their effect on broilers.
the development of FAC and its effects on broiler performance, meat composition, and fatty acid profile.

FAC is an effective feed additive that can be used to improve growth performance, meat quality, and fatty acid profile of broiler chickens.
